sn40.8:1.4: idha bhikkhu sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
sn40.8:1.6: so khohaṃ āvuso sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn40.8:1.7: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso iminā vihārena viharato ākiñcaññāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
sn40.8:2.1: atha kho maṃ āvuso bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
sn40.8:2.3: mā brāhmaṇa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ pamādo nevasaññānāsaññāyatane cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi nevasaññānāsaññāyatane cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi nevasaññānāsaññāyatane cittaṃ samādahāti.
sn40.8:2.4: so khohaṃ āvuso aparena samayena sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
sn40.8:2.5: yaṃ hi taṃ āvuso sammā vadamāno vadeyya …pe… mahābhiññataṃ pattoti.
